cards.subject: Strom
lines: King Thoradin founded the first human capital on this ground, and Arathor's people went out from it to found Lordaeron, Dalaran, Alterac, Gilneas, Kul Tiras and Stormwind.
The nobles left for those richer cities. The families who refused to go renamed what was left Stromgarde.

cards.subject: Thoradin's Wall
cards.tag: You ride through the gap in it
lines: Thrown up more than two thousand years before the game to stop the Amani trolls coming south.
It is the reason this zone exists: Arathor was a wall with a city behind it.
Now it is the front door, and you gallop through a hole in it without stopping.

cards.subject: The city nobody owns
lines: It is split three ways: the Syndicate hold the inner keep, the Boulderfist ogres hold the old mage district, and what is left of Stromgarde's army holds the military quarter.
All three are hostile to you, Alliance included.
You cannot walk into the first human city. You can only fight through it.

cards.subject: Refuge Pointe
cards.tag: The Alliance headquarters is a tent
lines: It is not a town. It is Stromgarde survivors camped on the road because their capital is four minutes' ride west and occupied.
The whole Alliance presence in the zone is people camping within sight of home.

cards.subject: Who the bandits are
lines: The Syndicate in Stromgarde and on the farms are not generic thugs. They are the remnants of Alterac — the kingdom that betrayed the Alliance and was dissolved for it.
Two fallen human kingdoms, occupying the same walls.

cards.subject: Prince Galen Trollbane
cards.tag: The last prince is a mob
lines: The heir to the oldest human throne sits in the Sanctum as a level forty-four elite, and both factions kill him. He gives no quests.
The Horde send a Darkspear hunter after Trol'kalar, his father's sword, sealed in stone in the tomb.
He dies guarding it.

cards.subject: Danath Trollbane
cards.tag: He is not in this zone
lines: Stromgarde's greatest commander went through the Dark Portal with the Alliance Expedition and never came back.
In here he is missing, and his statue stands in Stormwind's Valley of Heroes under an epitaph his uncle wrote.
The man who could have held these walls is stranded on another world.

cards.subject: Hammerfall
cards.tag: Named for a man who died getting them out
lines: The Horde town is a former Alliance internment camp — one of the largest — where orcs were held after the Second War until Thrall and Orgrim Doomhammer came for them.
Doomhammer was killed in that campaign. The freed orcs stayed on the site and named it for him.
Every orc there is standing in their own prison.

cards.subject: The Witherbark
lines: Forest trolls of Amani stock who fought beside the old Horde under Zul'jin, and abandoned the orcs after the defeat.
Up here they grudgingly allied with the Boulderfist ogres, specifically to fight the Horde at Hammerfall.
The orcs' old comrades are the reason that town keeps a wall.

cards.subject: Circle of Inner Binding
lines: One of the zone's stone circles, guarded by earth elementals, holding the strongest of the binding stones.
Something is imprisoned under these highlands. Through a shard of this circle, Myzrael reaches out and asks travellers to let her out.
Nothing anywhere says who built the circles.

cards.subject: Foulbelly
cards.tag: Beside the tower in the ogre quarter
lines: A rare Boulderfist ogre, level forty-two elite in here.
He respawns somewhere between thirty-two and forty-eight hours.
People who cleared that quarter a dozen times never saw him once.

cards.subject: Arathi Basin
cards.tag: Patch 1.7, and it is about grain
lines: Not a grudge, a supply war: farm, stables, blacksmith, lumber mill, gold mine.
The League of Arathor are Stromgarde's people trying to feed their kingdom back into existence.
The Defilers are Forsaken, and their stated goal is simply that it must not recover.

cards.subject: Faldir's Cove
lines: You reach the beach through a short tunnel southeast of Stromgarde's walls. The graded path was cut long after this.
Three Blackwater Raider ships came for treasure and a tide the naga raised sank two of them.
The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly are still down there. Only the Harbinger floats.
